document.title: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
document.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

sections.section_title: Prohibition of Advertisement of Certain Drugs for Treatment of Certain Diseases
sections.content: Section 3 prohibits advertisements alleging that any drug, traditional remedy, or magic cure can diagnose, cure, mitigate, or prevent specified conditions listed in the Schedule (including diabetes, cancer, blindness, and paralysis).

sections.section_title: Prohibition of Misleading Advertisements Relating to Drugs
sections.content: Section 4 prohibits advertisements that directly or indirectly give false impressions regarding the true character or efficacy of any drug, or make false therapeutic claims.
